_readme: The people tools/blender/make_people.py builds from MakeHuman (CC0). Each: MakeHuman targets (path under makehuman/data/targets, no extension) and their weights, mixed onto the base mesh; then fitted to our skeleton and body envelope. `outfit`: the garments he wears and their colours (tools/blender/clothes.py makes and drapes them, and bakes each a pixel texture). Output: assets/people/<id>.glb, <id>_<garment>.png, and <id>.json (what was done). `face`: how he looks, for the image model (tools/faces/paint_face.py) to paint onto his head. A person with "source": "tripo" is a Tripo model (assets/people/tripo/<id>.glb) fitted by tools/blender/fit_tripo.py instead; he comes dressed, so his outfit is empty. `eyes` (a fitted Tripo man): where his eyes are seen from straight in front, [x, y] in metres in our body space, his right eye first (measured once from a front view of his head: tools/characters/bold_paint.py --eye-grid); the bold paint lines his face's squares up on them.

outlaw.note: A hard man in his late thirties: lean, wiry, a little weathered.
outlaw.face: a hard, weathered frontier man in his late thirties, sun-darkened skin with a few lines, heavy dark brows over deep-set watchful eyes, a strong straight nose, a thick dark moustache over the lip, a few days' stubble on the jaw, dark hair at the temples and sideburns

stranger.note: The painting's man by image-to-3D (tools/characters/, Tripo), fitted by tools/blender/fit_tripo.py: he comes dressed, hat and all (a stopgap: his layered self is stranger_layered).
stranger.face: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty: deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble, long dark hair to his collar

stranger_layered.note: The same man in layers (docs/DESTRUCTION_BRIEF.md part 5): his body painted bare-headed and coatless (`model`), and each `piece` a garment modelled alone and hung on him. The hat is in; the coat piece is still to come (see CLAUDE.md status, 2026-10-04).
stranger_layered.face: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty: deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble, long dark hair to his collar

kid.note: The gang's Kid by image-to-3D from Sean's own front picture (tools/characters/: kid is given, kid_body and kid_hat painted from it), in layers: his body bare-headed (`model`) and his hat its own piece, so it can be shot off.
kid.face: a nervous young outlaw of about nineteen: thin, freckled and clean-shaven, worried brown eyes under a frown, short tousled brown hair

stranger2.note: The stranger by Rodin Gen-2.5 (tools/characters/rodin.py) from Sean's own front picture and the three views painted from it (the model test, 2026-10-06), fitted by tools/blender/fit_tripo.py with his joints found from his shape: he comes dressed, hat and all.
stranger2.face: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty: deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble, short dark hair

stranger2s.note: The Rodin stranger pushed toward the paintings' stylised realism (tools/characters/stylise.py, Sean's experiment, 2026-10-06): his brow and jaw heavier, his moustache thicker, his eyes and hands a little bigger, his skin's fine detail smoothed away; painted in the style and fitted as stranger2 is. Since 2026-10-07 he wears that paint on the Rodin man as made (`shape`): the push read as a cartoon (Sean).
stranger2s.face: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty: deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble, short dark hair
